name: Annotations Export
description: Drush-based export of assembled annotation context as a markdown file or an Obsidian vault.
project_description: Annotations Export adds a Drush command (annotations:export, alias ann:ex) that assembles a site's annotation context and writes it as a single markdown file/stdout or as an Obsidian vault (one .md file per target with YAML frontmatter and wikilink relationships). It reuses the annotations_context assembler and renderer and, as a privileged CLI caller, includes all annotation types by default. No web routes.
